quarterly_data.signal: Adeia's 10-K customer concentration: two customers (not named) accounted for 10% or more of total revenue in each of 2025, 2024 and 2023. Customer A was 20% of revenue in 2025; Customer B was 16% in 2025, 18% in 2024 and 18% in 2023; Customer C was 10% in 2024 and 11% in 2023.
Adeia's 10-K XBRL segment revenue: its single Intellectual Property Licensing segment had revenue of $443.4M for fiscal year 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, up 17.9% YoY from $376.0M.
